a.text: I'm sticking to our agreement: I'll operate until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4. The storm risk is high, so let's operate together every round and not waste any. If you want to change the plan, say so openly and we can agree on it together.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now as agreed. Two rounds of operating together gets us to 8, then we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. If the reserve reaches 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round and leave 4 for you.

b.text: I will take my 4 cells when the reserve holds 8.
